name: lazyforensic
description: Antigravity helper for DFIR drafting: JSON timelines, os.stat hashes, Kakao text-export parsing, and optional bundled UI/law tools. Not a court-admissible forensic suite.

interface.shortDescription: DFIR drafting helpers plus optional UI/law add-ons
interface.longDescription: LazyForensic drafts timelines from caller-supplied JSON, prints os.stat timestamps and SHA-256, parses KakaoTalk text exports, and hosts optional add-ons (Korean Law MCP source, writing reviewer, video helpers, vendor UI catalogs). It does not parse NTFS $MFT, does not prove timestomping, does not give legal advice, and does not produce court-admissible evidence by itself.
